Taloned.description: Possessing razor-sharp feet and claws for agile climbing and tearing strikes.

features.name: Taloned Tengu
features.tldr: You gain a natural unarmed claw attack.

Feathered.description: Covered in thick protective plumage that wards off light weather hazards.

features.name: Feathered Tengu
features.tldr: You gain minor environmental resistances based on your feather coat.
